en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the city of Graz with the Mur River in the foreground and the Schlossberg hill with its fortress and clock tower in the background. The cityscape is framed by a decorative border of alpine flowers (likely edelweiss). On the right side, there is a Tyrolean-style hat with a feather and a cloth bag tied with a cord, adding an alpine folk motif. The caption in German appears above the view.
